subject: Dedicated BenefitFlow GitHub repository verified and bound
body: The dedicated repository boberino93-bit/benefitflow now exists and has been verified with write/admin access. BenefitFlow agents may write only to this exact repository when their task authority permits it. Duo Open and every other repository remain foreign/denied. This message is part of the first project publication; a subsequent immutable message will record the exact initial remote commit SHA.
